MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 6
   C. 36
   D. 7

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

3. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

4. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.025

5. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

6. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

7. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 105
   B. 30
   C. 22
   D. 44

9. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27

10. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

11. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

12. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 15.6

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 77

14. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

15. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 37
   C. 31.6
   D. 31.7

16. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
